description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: C.J. Gardner-Johnson was diagnosed with a lower calf strain after being carted off from the Bills' practice on Saturday.
items.impact: It's good news for Johnson, who initially looked like he suffered a foot or Achilles injury. Of course, strains are no fun either, but it doesn't sound like this is anything major. He should be back soon for the Bills.
items.title: C.J. Gardner-Johnson (calf) diagnosed with calf strain

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) is believed to be OK after being carted off with an injury during the Chiefs practice on Saturday.
items.impact: While details are sparse for the moment, it's still good news for the Chiefs and their fans alike, who saw both Worthy and Cyrus Allen both exit practice, but both seem to be ok. This could still impact Worthy's fantasy performance, however, as he dealt with shoulder injuries all of last season, so fantasy managers will need to monitor this situation as updates emerge.
items.title: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) believed to be OK

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Malik Nabers was back practicing on Saturday.
items.impact: Nabers did not practice on Friday as part of a set schedule. He will continue to be eased back into practice.
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) returns to practice Saturday

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Cyrus Allen suffered a shin bruise at Saturday's practice.
items.impact: This is the best-case scenario for Allen, who was carted off the field on Saturday. The 2026 fifth-round pick has been turning some heads as one of Patrick Mahomes' top targets early in camp, so this is an injury to monitor.
items.title: Cyrus Allen diagnosed with shin bruise

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: The Denver Broncos will explore signing free agent Taysom Hill, according to Denver head coach Sean Payton.
items.impact: Hill played for Payton with the Saints, so it makes sense there would be interest on both sides. The 35-year-old has spent the last nine seasons in New Orleans and could carve out a bit of the "joker" role in Denver that Payton is known for.
items.title: Taysom Hill drawing interest from Denver Broncos

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Linebacker Devin White has agreed to a 1-year deal with the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: White has finally landed after a long summer of free agency, joining the Detroit linebacking corps. The veteran started all 17 games for the Raiders last season, totaling 174 tackles, the third-highest mark in the entire league.
items.title: Devin White signs 1-year contract with Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. was participating in team drills at practice on Saturday.
items.impact: Samuel returns to the practice field two days after returning to the 49ers on a one-year deal. He will be a player to continue to monitor throughout training camp heading into the season.
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. participates in team drills Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers rookie WR De'Zhaun Stribling is not practicing on Saturday due to hamstring tightness.
items.impact: Stribling becomes the 49ers latest wide receiver to go down with an injury. He'll figure to not be rushed back from a hamstring issue.
items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling (hamstring) not practicing Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons and G Matthew Bergeron have agreed to terms on a four-year, $96 million contract extension.
items.impact: Bergeron gets $60 million guaranteed in a deal. Atlanta has invested heavily in its guards between him and Chris Lindstrom. They continue to heavily invest in the offensive line.
items.title: Matthew Bergeron signs four-year extension with Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers placed WR Ricky Pearsall on injured reserve as he'll undergo season-ending surgery.
items.impact: Pearsall will miss the entire season after playing in just nine games last year. Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel and rookie De'Zhaun Stribling will see more opportunity.
items.title: Ricky Pearsall (knee) to undergo season-ending surgery, placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles says T Tristan Wirfs is moving around better.
items.impact: Wirfs remained sidelined with a hamstring injury. He could be back at practice soon.
items.title: Tristan Wirfs (hamstring) moving around better

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts signed RB Roydell Williams.
items.impact: Williams will compete for a depth role in the Colts backfield.
items.title: Roydell Williams signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts activated CJ Allen from the PUP list.
items.impact: Allen has been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: CJ Allen activated by Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kool-Aid McKinstry told reporters his ankle isn't hurt that bad.
items.impact: McKinstry left practice early on Thursday. He is day-to-day for now.
items.title: Kool-Aid McKinstry dealing with minor ankle injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos signed CB Sam Webb.
items.impact: Webb will compete for a depth role in the Broncos corner back room.
items.title: Sam Webb signs with Broncos

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills released Wande Owens.
items.impact: Owens will figure to seek another opportunity in training camp.
items.title: Wande Owens released by Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills signed CB D.J. Miller Jr.
items.impact: Miller will compete for a depth role in the Bills wide receiver room.
items.title: D.J. Miller Jr. signs with Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets signed WR Cam Camper.
items.impact: Camper will compete for a depth role in the Jets wide receiver room.
items.title: Cam Camper signs with Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets waived WR Gee Scott Jr.
items.impact: Scott will likely clear waivers.
items.title: Gee Scott Jr. waived by Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said DT Ashton Gillotte left Friday's practice with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is. Gillotte will continue to be further evaluated.
items.title: Ashton Gillotte battling hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens activated CB Bilhal Kone from the PUP list.
items.impact: Kone has been cleared to return to training camp.
items.title: Bilhal Kone (knee) activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens activated LB Adisa Isaac from the PUP list.
items.impact: Isaac has been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: Adisa Isaac (elbow) activated from PUP list
